_doc: Real `sinatra-contrib-4.2.1/lib/sinatra/extension.rb` vendored 1:1 under `vendor/sinatra/extension.rb`. Fifth sinatra-contrib fixture; exercises the method-recorder + replay pattern (`extend Sinatra::Extension` captures every Sinatra::Base method call via method_missing for later replay via the `registered(base)` hook). Surfaced and fixed a real rubyrs gap: `try_method_missing` only triggered for Value::Object receivers, swallowing method_missing handlers on Class/Module receivers like the Extension module's recorder. Both the bareword module form (`module Ext; extend Sinatra::Extension; ...; end`) and the block-form `new` (`Ext = Sinatra::Extension.new do ...; end`) are exercised.
name: sinatra_extension_smoke
